title: Ordinary-to-compact-support comparison for arbitrary projective-line Ext maps
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring and N a natural number with NA=0. Fix normalized finite twist transport t [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows] and a family d of arbitrary-base P1 splittings satisfying ArbitraryBaseFiniteP1BaseChange [lem-sp-tower-p1-arbitrary-base-integrals]. Let f:X->S be proper and i:X~ProjectiveLine(S) an isomorphism over S, where N is a unit in global sections. For ANY class kappa in Ext^2(Delta_* A_P,A_W(1)), with P=ProjectiveLine(S), W=P times_S P, there are a compact-support trace-diagonal datum D for (f,A_X(1)[2]) and a constant-complex comparison c:Li^* A_P~A_X. Its first compact-support integral composite equals c^-1 Li^*(ordinaryFiniteP1DiagonalSupportedMap(false,kappa) followed by arbitraryBaseFiniteP1DiagonalTrace(false)) c. Its second composite, using the normalized shifted-line pullback t along f, equals the same expression for true. Compact-support composites are those of [lem-sf-diagonal-kernel-integral-triangles]. No composite is asserted to be identity; no Kummer specification is required of kappa.

source.place: Both coordinate diagonal integrals and their two triangle computations, followed by the inverse-projection trace counit.

proof.text: Construct the trace and supported class explicitly by the self-product map, proper exchange, normalized line comparisons, and proper forget-supports; use constantComparison for c. No existence theorem is used to select these arrows.

Apply sectionComparison before inserting the Ext representative. Naturality of projectionComparison transports its direct image; functoriality and the inverse identities cancel the two coefficient comparisons. This proves the source comparison for every supported Ext representative in Lean.

Apply traceComparison to the supplied base-change-compatible splitting family. Compose the source and trace equations and use preservation of composition by Li*. For the two Boolean values unfold diagonalUnit and coordinateTrace, obtaining exactly the two equations in the statement.

proof_origin.place: Explicit construction and factorization into the section-unit comparison and the trace base-change comparison; naturality and composition are proved in Lean.

theorem sfP1IntegralTransport
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (d : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      ArbitraryBaseFiniteP1Splitting A N hA t T hT)
    (hbc : ArbitraryBaseFiniteP1BaseChange A N hA t d)
    (S X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f]
    (i : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (hi : i.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) = f)
    (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (κ : Ext
      ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.diagonal (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S))).obj
        (ordinaryFiniteConstant A (ProjectiveLine S)))
      (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine
        (pullback (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)) N A hA) 2) :
    ∃ D : TraceDiagonalDatum A f ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA X)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧),
      ∃ c : (ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).obj
          (ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S)) ≅
            derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X,
        ((SfDiagonalKernel.diagonalFirst A f).hom.app
            (derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X) ≫
          (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.fst f f)).map
            D.diagonalClass ≫ SfDiagonalKernel.traceFirst A D =
          c.inv ≫ (ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).map
            (ordinaryFiniteP1DiagonalSupportedMap A N hA S false κ ≫
              arbitraryBaseFiniteP1DiagonalTrace A N hA t d S hS false) ≫ c.hom) ∧
        ((TraceDiagonalDatum.idIsoDiagonalSnd (Λ := A) f).hom.app
            (derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X) ≫
          (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.snd f f)).map
            D.diagonalClass ≫
          SfDiagonalKernel.traceSecond A D
            (CoordinateTrace.shiftedLine A (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine S N A hA) 1)
            (ordinaryFiniteShiftedLinePullback A N hA t f hS).symm =
          c.inv ≫ (ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).map
            (ordinaryFiniteP1DiagonalSupportedMap A N hA S true κ ≫
              arbitraryBaseFiniteP1DiagonalTrace A N hA t d S hS true) ≫ c.hom)
